lines.en: The blazezard creeps along the hot stone.
Thin smoke seeps from between its scales.
Its tail drags a scorched line.

lines.zh: 它每一步都烧出一点火星
lines.en: Each step strikes a few sparks.
It skirts the lava and creeps on.

lines.zh: 它的爪子按在石上，石头发红
lines.en: Its claws leave the stone glowing.

lines.zh: 它把头低低地伸在前面
lines.en: Its head reaches low in front.

lines.zh: 它停下来，尾巴摆了一下
lines.en: It stops and swings its tail.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸把空气烤得发颤
lines.en: Its breath makes the air shimmer.

lines.zh: 它缓缓朝你的方向移动
lines.en: It moves slowly your way.
The ridge on its back arches.

lines.zh: 它走过的地方冒着热气
lines.en: Heat rises where it has passed.

lines.zh: 焰蜥趴在石上，慢慢呼吸
lines.en: The blazezard lies on the stone, breathing slowly.

lines.zh: 它的鳞片一明一暗，像余烬
lines.en: Its scales glow and dim like embers.

lines.zh: 它的舌头伸出来舔了舔石面
lines.en: Its tongue licks the stone.
The stone shines where it licked.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴尖轻轻敲着地
lines.en: Its tail tip taps the ground.

lines.zh: 它把身体压得更贴石头
lines.en: It presses itself flatter.
Its eyes are narrow slits.

lines.zh: 它打了个嗝，冒出一小股烟
lines.en: It belches a little smoke.

lines.zh: 它的爪子慢慢收进掌里
lines.en: Its claws slide back in.
It listens to something under the stone.
The blazezard lifts its head at you.
Its scales brighten.

lines.zh: 它侧过身子，把自己撑大
lines.en: It turns side-on and makes itself look bigger.
Its tongue tests the air.
It shifts a little toward you.
Its tail lifts and drops.

lines.zh: 它张开嘴，热气扑到你脸上
lines.en: It opens its mouth; heat hits your face.
It has noted where you are.
It backs half a foot and settles.
Its eyes never shift away.
The blazezard's scales dim.
It retreats, tail lashing.

lines.zh: 它的身上掉下几片焦鳞
lines.en: Scorched scales fall from it.
It gives a hoarse sound.
Its rasping breaks for half a beat.
It presses tighter to the ground.
It edges toward the hot stone.
The light in its mouth goes out.

lines.zh: 它重新张开嘴，火又亮起
lines.en: It gapes again and the fire returns.
It does not retreat, only grows warier.

lines.zh: 焰蜥朝你手上的东西爬来
lines.en: The blazezard crawls toward what you hold.
It sniffs and its snout wrinkles.
It bites down; sparks fly.
The item scorches in its mouth.

lines.zh: 它把不合口的东西吐出来
lines.en: What it dislikes, it spits out.

lines.zh: 它对肉比对别的东西有兴趣
lines.en: Meat interests it more than anything else.
It crawls a circle around you.
It stops and waits for a second.
Its tail swings with interest.
It suddenly drops low.

lines.zh: 焰蜥撞在你腿上，烫得厉害
lines.en: The blazezard hits your leg, searing hot.
As you recoil, it presses in.

lines.zh: 它的爪子刮过你的鞋面
lines.en: Its claws rake your shoe.
The stone cracks under the impact.
It backs off with a tail lash.
Its scales strike a spark.
It lowers itself again.
Its breath grows hotter.
It goes around you, taking another angle.

lines.zh: 它的目光始终在你身上
lines.en: Its eyes stay on you.

lines.zh: 两只焰蜥把尾巴绕在一起
lines.en: Two blazezards twine their tails.
Their scales glow in alternation.
They crawl slowly along each other.
The stone glows red beneath them.

lines.zh: 它们的呼吸合成一股热
lines.en: Their breath merges into one heat.
Two heads rest on one stone.
Sparks jump between them.
They lie perfectly still.
The heat around them slowly spreads.
Two scorch marks remain on the stone.
The blazezard snaps up the food.

lines.zh: 它把东西烧了一下再吞
lines.en: It scorches it before swallowing.

lines.zh: 它对不合口的东西喷出一口气
lines.en: It puffs at what it dislikes.
A claw pins the item down.
It drags the item onto hot stone.
It bites the prize in two.
It leaves half on the stone.
Done, it licks the ash from its mouth.

lines.zh: 它抬头，眼睛里还有火光
lines.en: It looks up, fire still in its eyes.
Then it starts to crawl away.
The blazezard's scales flare all at once.
It pushes its body up.
Orange light kindles in its mouth.
The stone starts to smoke.
It opens its mouth your way.

lines.zh: 一声低响从喉咙里出来
lines.en: A low sound comes from its throat.
Its tail rises slowly.
It starts closing in.
Its claws burn the ground.
Its slit pupils nail you down.
It is no longer lying down.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸，短促得像喷气。
lines.en: Its breath comes in short, jetting bursts.

lines.zh: 热气把它周围的空气扭曲
lines.en: Heat bends the air around it.
It is ready to spit something.
The blazezard circles you slowly.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴在地上扫出一道痕
lines.en: Its tail draws a line on the ground.
It edges in and pulls back.
The light in its mouth never fades.
It stops upwind of you.
Its scales grow brighter.

lines.zh: 它在等一个不被躲开的距离
lines.en: It waits for a range you cannot dodge.
Its shadow wavers in the heat.
It drops very low.

lines.zh: 它的喉咙里传出咕噜声
lines.en: A gurgle comes from its throat.
It stops and holds its breath.
That silence is wrong somehow.

lines.zh: 它已经对准了你的胸口
lines.en: It has aimed at your chest.

lines.zh: 石头的裂缝里冒出火苗
lines.en: Flame rises from cracks in the stone.

lines.zh: 焰蜥一口咬在你护甲上
lines.en: The blazezard bites your armour.

lines.zh: 它吐出一股火，扑到面门
lines.en: It spits fire into your face.
Its tail whips your flank.
It leaps and rakes with its claws.

lines.zh: 它的身体撞得你退了半步
lines.en: Its body knocks you back half a step.

lines.zh: 它的牙咬合时溅出火星
lines.en: Sparks fly as its teeth close.

lines.zh: 它咬空，热气喷在你脸上
lines.en: It misses; heat blasts your face.
It withdraws and gapes again.

lines.zh: 地面被它砸出一圈焦痕
lines.en: A scorched ring marks the ground.
The second bite comes closer.
Its own fire drives it back.

lines.zh: 它的鳞被撞得掉了几片
lines.en: Several scales break loose.
It crawls slowly back onto the hot stone.

lines.zh: 我一口咬下去，火星溅在你甲上。
lines.en: I bite down and sparks splash across your armor.
Smoke rises from a crack first.
The blazezard pulls out of the fissure.
Its scales are still alight.

lines.zh: 它抖了抖，火星落了一地
lines.en: It shakes; sparks rain down.
It lifts its head and looks at you.
It levers its body up.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴扫过地面，留下焦痕
lines.en: Its tail sweeps a scorch onto the ground.
Heat rises behind it.

lines.zh: 它的爪子抓着石头往前
lines.en: Its claws grip the stone as it comes.
It stops an arm's length away.
Its breath makes the air quiver.
It opens its mouth.

lines.zh: 火焰落在它身上，像被吞了
lines.en: Fire lands on it and seems swallowed.

lines.zh: 落地时它的身体磕在石上
lines.en: It hits stone hard on landing.

lines.zh: 水浇下来，它冒起大片白汽
lines.en: Water hits and it throws a wall of steam.

lines.zh: 冲击掀掉它背上一片鳞
lines.en: The blast strips a plate off its back.

lines.zh: 箭扎进鳞缝，它扭了一下
lines.en: An arrow wedges between scales; it twists.

lines.zh: 怪力钻进体内，它的火乱了
lines.en: Odd force enters and its fire gutters.

lines.zh: 它的火光弱得几乎看不见
lines.en: Its glow fades almost to nothing.
Lightning strikes and it goes rigid.

lines.zh: 虚空抽走热气，它越来越暗
lines.en: The void draws off its heat and it dims.
